description: No plugin: subagents inherit the session model at its default effort
No plugin: every subagent on haiku (CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL=haiku, CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL_FORCE=1)
No plugin: every subagent on sonnet (CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL=sonnet, CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL_FORCE=1)
No plugin: every subagent on sonnet at medium effort (CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_EFFORT=medium)
No plugin: every subagent on sonnet at high effort (CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_EFFORT=high)
No plugin: every subagent on opus (CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL=opus, CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL_FORCE=1)
No plugin: every subagent on fable (CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL=fable, CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL_FORCE=1); needs Fable access
No plugin: session model opusplan (--model opusplan). Opus plans only in plan mode, which a headless dontAsk run never enters, so this runs Sonnet throughout
No plugin: a sonnet session with an opus advisor (--advisor opus); needs the Anthropic API, Claude Platform on AWS or Claude Models on Google Cloud, on a subscription or API billing
